outcome: Infant admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The abstract discusses current clinical practice and recommendations for caring for pregnant women with diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
finding: The presented clinical practice aims for intensive targets for blood pressure and glycaemic control during pregnancy, emphasizing multidisciplinary team work and patient-centered care.
mod_finding: Diabetic chronic kidney disease increases the risk of Caesarean section.
